title: Verificacao final matematica e visual da imagem por PN
purpose: Verificar enquadramento, concordancia entre vistas, proporcoes reais, medidas, escala, camera, clipping, fidelidade multivista e consistencia final antes da liberacao visual.

mathematical_checks.cross_view_scale: common px/mm across dimensional orthographic views
mathematical_checks.calibrated_view: 3D landmark reprojection RMSE using stored 3x4 camera projection
mathematical_checks.framing: minimum margins, clipping, optional centered-margin balance
mathematical_checks.dimensions: displayed H/W/D equals controlled values, no raster-derived dimensions

default_tolerances.note: Defaults are project starting values, not technical-standard limits. Frozen project tolerances may be stricter and cannot be loosened silently.

repair_policy: Step 7 verifies and routes only. Geometry failures return to Step 5; document/composition failures return to Step 6; LI/load quantity failures return to Step 4.
